auth.headline: Your work life, in one place
auth.lede: Attendance, leave, claims and payslips for Big-Matrix Solutions.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passkeyFailed: We couldn't sign you in with that passkey. Use your email instead.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.lede: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s

twoFactor.title: Confirm it's you
twoFactor.lede: Your role needs a second step. Use your passkey or the code from your authenticator app.

auth.suspended: We couldn't sign you in. If you think this is wrong, contact HR.

invite.title: Welcome to {{company}}
invite.lede: You've been invited to the HR system as {{email}}. Continue to get a sign-in code by email.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask HR to send a new one.

recover.title: Can't sign in?
items: Lost your passkey? Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey from Security.
Privileged roles: use a recovery code at the verification step.
Lost everything, or can't reach your email? Ask HR or the system administrator to reset your sign-in methods.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.reauth: For your security, confirm it's you before continuing.

security.title: Security
security.enrolGate: Your role needs a passkey or an authenticator app before you can continue. Add one now.
security.passkeysLede: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. A passkey is the strongest and easiest option.
security.removePasskeyConfirm: You won't be able to sign in with {{name}} any more.
security.authenticatorLede: Use an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator to get 6-digit codes.
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
security.confirmCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
security.recoveryLede: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.

errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code isn't right or has expired. Check the email or send a new code.
errors.TOTP_INVALID: That code isn't right. Check your authenticator app, or use a recovery code.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this. Ask HR if you think you should.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: For your security, confirm it's you before continuing.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: We couldn't sign you in. If you think this is wrong, contact HR.
errors.CSRF_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: We couldn't verify this request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You can't approve your own request. It's waiting for another approver.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this while you were editing. We've loaded the latest version. Review it and try again.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This record has changed status, so that action isn't possible any more.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: Someone already signs in with this email.
errors.WORK_EMAIL_TAKEN: Another employee already has this work email.
errors.EMPLOYEE_ALREADY_LINKED: This employee already has a sign-in account.
errors.DEPARTMENT_CODE_TAKEN: Another department already uses this code.
errors.DUPLICATE: This value is already in use.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This action is already being processed. Refresh in a moment.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This action is already being processed. Refresh in a moment.
errors.PAYROLL_RUN_LOCKED: This payroll is locked. Add an adjustment to the next run instead.
errors.PAYROLL_RUN_EXISTS: A regular run for this month already exists.
errors.SELF_MANAGER: An employee can't be their own manager.
errors.REPORTING_CYCLE: This person already reports to this employee, so they can't be their manager.
errors.NOT_CHECKED_IN: You haven't checked in today, so you can't check out. Request a correction if you forgot.
errors.OVERLAPPING_LEAVE: You already have leave on these dates.
errors.PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Payments don't match net pay. Check the amounts.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large. The limit is 10 MB.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: This file type isn't allowed. Use PDF, JPG or PNG.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: You don't have enough leave of this type. Shorten the request or choose another type.
errors.LEAVE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: You aren't eligible for this leave type yet.
errors.LEAVE_NO_WORKING_DAYS: These dates are all weekends or holidays.
errors.PAYROLL_MISSING_SALARY_STRUCTURE: Some employees have no approved salary structure for this period. Add them, then recalculate.
errors.PAYROLL_NEGATIVE_NET: An employee's net pay is below zero. Check their deductions and adjustments.
errors.PAYROLL_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: An amount isn't in BDT. Correct it, then recalculate.
errors.PAYROLL_MIDPERIOD_SALARY_CHANGE_UNCONFIR: A salary changes during this period. Set the mid-period salary rule in payroll settings before calculating.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL_NOTE_REQUIRED: Explain why you're approving your own run (at least 20 characters).
errors.BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION: This can't be done because of a company rule. Ask HR for details.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again. If it keeps happening, give HR this reference: {{requestId}}.
errors.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a minute.
errors.NETWORK: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.

errorPage.title: We hit a problem
errorPage.lede: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, give HR the reference below.
